early_stage: Yellow streaks running from leaf midrib to leaf margin
Continuous or broken yellow lines across the leaf
intermediate_stage: Streaks appear scattered or arranged in bands
Reduced plant vigor and smaller plant size
advanced_stage: Yellow streaks turn brown or black with leaf aging
Possible pseudostem internal rot and dieback in severe cases

transmission: Activation of integrated viral DNA in plant genome under stress
disease_cycle.latent_behavior: Virus fragments can integrate into banana genome and reactivate under stress conditions

effects: Yield losses depending on cultivar and infection intensity
impact.estimated_losses: Up to about 6% annually in some regions, higher in susceptible cultivars

vector_control: Use horticultural oils or soap sprays
quarantine: Follow FAO germplasm movement guidelines for Musa species
Use certified disease-free tissue culture plants

spread_risk_factors: Plant stress conditions activating integrated virus DNA
references: CSIRO Publishing – Diseases of Fruit Crops in Australia (2009)
Pacific Pests, Pathogens and Weeds Database
Bioversity International – FAO Musa Germplasm Movement Guidelines
